selection_method: Existing official eligible-catalogue 5 mass quantiles x zero-SFR + 4 positive-sSFR quartiles; 19 randomly chosen strata get 4 new galaxies, 6 get 3. SRS without replacement within each stratum. Random partition of selected94 into60/14/20. No image-dependent selection.
limitations: No catalogue dust mass, morphology class or true inclination. Gas fraction and gas surface-density proxies are metadata-derived; they are neither dust measurements nor morphology labels. Fixed old26 inclusion is conditional and historical, not assigned a population inclusion probability.
